limits: Equivalence holds for these scenarios only. A match proves the traces the scenarios record are equal, not that every behaviour is.
Files other than the targets come from the working tree on both sides; otherChangedFiles lists any that also differ.
Coverage is V8 block coverage mapped through the bundle source map; a line counts as run when any of its generated code ran.
